objective: Preregister exactly ONE candidate before any run: the refuted pead_sue_eps_event signal card (reports/research/signal-cards/pead_sue_eps_event.json), rebuilt with visible_at moved from the first NYSE session after the 10-Q/10-K filing date to the first NYSE session after the 8-K Item-2.02 earnings-release exhibit's EDGAR acceptanceDateTime. Same sue_eps definition, universe, top_n, threshold, primary_horizon, costs, and redated placebo as the refuted card; only the timestamp join changes.

parameters.rationale: Identical mechanism to the refuted pead_sue_eps_event card (Foster-Olsen-Shevlin 1984 seasonal-random-walk SUE, Bernard-Thomas 1989/1990 drift). The only change: value = sue_eps as already computed by scripts/build_sec_xbrl_fundamentals.py (unchanged), but the row's trade_date (visible_at) is now the first NYSE session after the nearest-preceding 8-K Item-2.02 filing's acceptanceDateTime for the same CIK, instead of the first NYSE session after the 10-Q/10-K filing itself. This is the reopen condition the refuted card's own amendment note named for itself (fundamentals-v1-manifest.json, 2026-09-24T05:20:00Z).

join_specification.description: New feature table data/features/sue_8k_visible/{year}.parquet, columns (symbol, trade_date, value), built once by a new script (scripts/build_sue_8k_visible.py, does not modify any existing lane/batch/signal_card file) and then read unmodified by signal_card.py's existing --source/--column event-mode path.
join_specification.input_left: data/features/sec_fundamentals_daily/{year}.parquet WHERE days_since_report = 0 AND sue_eps IS NOT NULL (i.e. exactly the rows the refuted card's event triggered on; symbol, cik, trade_date=old_visible_at, sue_eps)
join_specification.match_rule: For each left row, the right row with the same cik and the largest acceptance_utc such that acceptance_utc's NYSE usable-session date <= old_visible_at, within a 65-calendar-day lookback window (covers the longest routine gap between an earnings 8-K and its follow-on 10-Q/10-K, ~45 days, plus slack). No match within the window -> row dropped (fallback above), not substituted with the old date.
join_specification.usable_session_rule: Convert acceptance_utc to America/New_York local time (zoneinfo, matching build_earnings_events.py's own already-verified Eastern-time handling). If the local calendar date is a US equity trading session (open_composer.market_calendar.us_equity_session_close) and the local time is at or before that session's close (16:00, or 13:00 on an early-close day), the usable session is that same trading date; otherwise (after close, or a non-trading day) the usable session is open_composer.market_calendar.next_us_equity_session(local_date). This mirrors the existing as-first-reported PIT rule in scripts/build_sec_xbrl_fundamentals.py (a same-day filing is conservatively usable only from the next session unless known to be intraday) but adds the actual intraday cutoff the 8-K acceptance timestamp makes possible and the filing-date version could not use.
join_specification.unit_test: tests/test_build_sue_8k_visible.py asserts a synthetic 8-K accepted at 20:00 ET on trading day t maps to usable session t+1 (not t), and one accepted at 10:00 ET on trading day t maps to usable session t.

data_v1_sec_fundamentals_daily_sue_eps_p.note: right table built under docs/plan-earnings-text-forward-test-2026-09-22.zh.md T1; this iteration only reads it, does not rebuild or extend it.

label_v1_signal_card_next_open_forward_r.definition: signal_card.py's own forward_returns(): formation at the close of trade_date, entry at the next session's open, forward returns at h=1/5/20/60 sessions, unchanged

validation_v1_signal_card_event_mode_red.placebo: signal_card.py's own built-in event-mode redated placebo (20 seeds, each event moved to a random session of the same stock within half a year), reused unchanged
windows: 2024+ (identical to full under this data constraint, reported separately as the admission rule requires)

cost_v1_signal_card_10_20bps_next_open.basis: sum|dw| turnover, unchanged from signal_card.py COSTS_BPS

benchmark_v1_signal_card_library_v1_admi.event_long_rule: beats_redated AND t_dates >= 3 at the primary horizon AND calendar-time book positive excess at 20bp in the full and 2024+ windows
benchmark_v1_signal_card_library_v1_admi.k1_k2_reported_for_information_only: docs/runbook-autonomous-round.zh.md section 5 K1/K2 thresholds (offset-median Sharpe vs S3 anchor/stress 1.49/0.81) do not formally apply to a single signal card (not a sleeve/strategy compared to S3); reported in results.json as context only, not as a gate.

refuted_predecessor.reopen_condition_quote: usable session = first NYSE session after the 10-Q/10-K filing date, which usually lags the earnings press release (8-K item 2.02) by days to weeks; the card measures drift after the XBRL filing, the tradeable version with free data
